statement: For UIGS Android visual capture, successful connected/instrumentation test completion does not prove that a later app-private artifact is still a valid PNG; screenshot creation, extraction, and binary validation must be an explicit capture lifecycle.

scope.notes: Scoped to screenshot lifecycle and extraction.

review.rationale: Conservative migration from validated legacy record BUG.UIGS.ANDROID_CAPTURE.CONNECTED_TEST_ARTIFACT_EXTRACTION; statement is bounded to the failure mode and remediation already evidenced by that record.
